onetoys.configuration.recipe_tweaks.repl: Crafting recipes that reliably replace vanilla Minecraft recipes when enabled.

Replaces vanilla's lever recipe with a recipe requiring redstone dust.
Replaces vanilla's respawn anchor recipe with a reliable crafting recipe (Ender Pearl + Crying Obsidian + Gold Ingots).

onetoys.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.mo: Tweaks and adjustments to vanilla mobs and creatures.
Master switch to enable or disable all mob tweaks.
Tweaks, bug fixes, and TPS optimizations for vanilla mob AI.
Master switch for mob AI tweaks, bug fixes, and TPS optimizations.
Fixes mobs losing targets at close range, 1-second combat chase pauses (MC-198068), double attacks upon target switch (MC-191642), and target dimension mismatch (MC-149563).
Allows spiders and wolves to deal damage mid-air during leap attacks (MC-49129) and eliminates erratic head snapping during combat (MC-248707).
Prevents mobs from spinning continuously on slabs, farmland, scaffolding (MC-157645) and in shallow water (MC-129293).
Allows mobs to freely pathfind and walk across rails instead of treating them as impassable barriers.
Allows mobs to leap across 1-block empty spaces and gaps between platforms (parkour traversal).
Allow Walking on Leaves & Water Plants
Allows mobs to freely pathfind and walk across leaves, lily pads, and big dripleaves.
Reduces the minimum no-spawn perimeter around players from vanilla's 24 blocks to a tight 3x3 block box around the player.
Minimum distance in blocks from players where mobs can spawn (1.5 blocks = 3x3 block box, 24 = vanilla).
Limits reactive path recalculations in ServerLevel#sendBlockUpdated to mobs within 8 blocks of the modified block.
Throttles heavy 3D block scanning in RemoveBlockGoal (zombie turtle egg targeting).
Dynamically reduces goalSelector and targetSelector tick rates (DAB) for distant mobs out of combat.
Distance in blocks to the nearest player at which dynamic AI throttling begins.
Special monster variants and combat behaviors.
Master switch for special monster behaviors and variants.
Chance (0.0 - 1.0) for a newly spawned monster to gain a special ability (0.25 = 25%).
Adult zombies that move at player sprinting speed.
Baby zombies that walk at normal player walking speed instead of sprinting.
Switches its bow or crossbow for a bone at close range (dealing stone sword damage) and switches back when the target retreats.
Chance (0.0 - 1.0) for a Smart Skeleton to spawn with a crossbow instead of a bow (0.20 = 20%).
Moves in short ground slides instead of jumping, and stops to swell up before launching a strong forward ground dash that can step up 1 block.
Keeps its distance instead of melee attacking and spits Tangled Thread that deals 0.1 damage and places cobwebs.
Spawns unarmed, keeps its distance from targets, shoots normal wither skulls every few seconds and a dangerous blue wither skull every 30 seconds.
Enable or disable tweaks applied to goats.
When enabled, goats drop 1-2 mutton when killed (cooked if killed while on fire), exactly like sheep.
When enabled, milking goats triggers a cooldown before they can be milked again.
Milking cooldown duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second, 6000 ticks = 5 minutes). Set to 0 to disable cooldown.
When enabled, feeding goats wheat clears their milking cooldown.
Enable or disable tweaks applied to cows.
When enabled, milking cows triggers a cooldown before they can be milked again.
Milking cooldown duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second, 1200 ticks = 1 minute). Set to 0 to disable cooldown.
When enabled, feeding cows wheat clears their milking cooldown.
Enable or disable tweaks applied to mooshrooms.
When enabled, milking mooshrooms with a bucket triggers a cooldown before they can be milked again.
Milking cooldown duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second, 1200 ticks = 1 minute). Set to 0 to disable cooldown.
When enabled, harvesting stew from mooshrooms with a bowl triggers a cooldown before they can be milked for stew again.
Stew milking cooldown duration in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second, 1200 ticks = 1 minute). Set to 0 to disable cooldown.
When enabled, feeding mooshrooms wheat clears their milking and stew cooldowns.
onetoys.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.it: Item Tweaks
Tweaks and adjustments to items and equipment.
Enable Item Tweaks
Master switch to enable or disable all item tweaks.
Disable Charcoal
When enabled, charcoal is disabled. Recipes producing charcoal (such as smelting logs) are removed, and charcoal cannot be burned as furnace fuel.
Recovery Compass Tweaks
Tweaks specific to the recovery compass.
Enable Recovery Compass Tweaks
Enable or disable tweaks applied to the recovery compass.
Persist on Death
When enabled, recovery compasses persist through death, avoiding drops and gravestone storage.
Death Coordinates Tooltip
When enabled, holding Shift while hovering over a recovery compass displays the coordinates and dimension of your last death.
Death Coordinates Hotbar Display
When enabled, right-clicking with a recovery compass in hand toggles displaying your last death coordinates above the hotbar.
Stopwatch Tweaks
Features and adjustments for the Stopwatch item.
Enable Stopwatch
Master switch to enable the Stopwatch item and its recipe.
Stopwatch Hotbar Display
When enabled, holding an active or paused stopwatch displays its live dynamic timer above the hotbar.
onetoys.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.mi: Tweaks and adjustments to block breaking and mining mechanics.
Master switch to enable or disable all mining tweaks.
Removes the artificial 5-tick (0.25s) cooldown delay between breaking consecutive blocks in Survival mode.
Also removes the 5-tick cooldown delay between breaking consecutive blocks in Creative mode (allowing continuous 20 blocks/sec breaking when holding left-click).
onetoys.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.sl: Tweaks and adjustments to sleeping and beds.
Master switch to enable or disable all sleeping tweaks.
When enabled, sleeping in or using beds does not set or override your respawn point. Forced spawn points and respawn anchors remain unaffected.
Tweaks and adjustments to the respawn anchor block, fuel items, and dimension compatibility.
Master switch to enable or disable all respawn anchor tweaks.

Item or tag used as fuel for the respawn anchor. Default: 'minecraft:echo_shard'. If empty or invalid, defaults to 'minecraft:glowstone'. When set to another item, glowstone is no longer accepted as fuel.
A comma-separated list of dimension IDs where the respawn anchor will not work and will explode upon interaction. Leave empty to allow in all dimensions (including Overworld and End).
onetoys.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.st: Stack Tweaks
Custom stack size adjustments managed via 'config/onetoys/stacks.toml'.
Enable Stack Tweaks
Master switch to enable or disable all item stack size tweaks.
Open stacks.toml
Opens 'config/onetoys/stacks.toml' in your system's default text editor.
Saddles Stack to 16
When enabled, saddles can stack up to 16.
Boats Stack to 16
When enabled, boats, chest boats, and rafts can stack up to 16.
Minecarts Stack to 16
When enabled, all minecart variants can stack up to 16.
Beds Stack to 16
When enabled, beds can stack up to 16.
Potions Stack to 16
When enabled, regular, splash, and lingering potions can stack up to 16.
Stews & Soups Stack to 16
When enabled, mushroom stew, beetroot soup, rabbit stew, and suspicious stew can stack up to 16.
Ender Pearls Stack to 64
When enabled, ender pearls can stack up to 64 instead of 16.
Snowballs Stack to 64
When enabled, snowballs can stack up to 64 instead of 16.
Eggs Stack to 64
When enabled, eggs can stack up to 64 instead of 16.
onetoys.configuration.gameplay_tweaks.we: Wet Tweaks
Tweaks and mechanics related to water exposure, rain, and wetness.
Enable Wet Tweaks
Master switch to enable or disable all features in the Wet category.
Wet Duration (Ticks)
Duration in ticks an entity remains wet after leaving water or rain (20 ticks = 1 second).
Heat Source Drying Multiplier
Drying rate multiplier when near an active heat source (campfires, furnaces, lava, fire).
Accelerated Fire Extinguishing
Whether wet entities extinguish active fire significantly faster.
Fire Negate Chance
Chance (0.0 - 1.0) for a wet entity to completely negate catching fire or fire damage.
Wet Spiders Cannot Climb
When enabled, wet spiders lose the ability to climb walls.
Wet Creepers Cannot Explode
When enabled, wet creepers cannot explode and fizzle out with steam.
Matted Wool From Wet Sheep
When enabled, shearing a wet sheep yields matted wool instead of standard colored wool.
Rain Speeds Up Crop Growth
When enabled, crops exposed to rain grow significantly faster during rainstorms.
Stable Farmland
When enabled, dry farmland does not revert to dirt on its own over time. Mobs and player trampling are unaffected and can still revert farmland to dirt.
Cold Water Freezing
When enabled, water in very cold biomes (based on biome temperature) applies the freezing effect, just like powder snow.
Cold Water Temperature Threshold
Maximum biome temperature threshold for water to be considered freezing cold (vanilla freezing/snow threshold is 0.15; cold oceans are 0.10).
Wet Player Freezing
When enabled, wet players gradually freeze in cold biomes, deferring if freezing from powder snow, freezing water, or other primary causes.
Wet Player Freezing Interval (Ticks)
Interval in ticks between each increment of freezing for wet players in cold biomes (1 = same as powder snow, 5 = 5x slower).
